div.span: Rate-Monotonic Scheduling (RMS) — Fixed-Priority Preemptive | Hyperperiod = LCM(50, 200, 1000, 1000, 5000) = 5000 ms

div.div:
Liu & Layland (1973) Sufficient Condition for n = 5 tasks:
U_bound = n × (2^(1/n) − 1) = 5 × (2^(1/5) − 1) = 5 × (2^0.2 − 1) = 5 × 0.14870 = 0.74349
Total System Utilization:
U_total = U₁ + U₂ + U₃ + U₄ + U₅
U_total = C₁/T₁ + C₂/T₂ + C₃/T₃ + C₄/T₄ + C₅/T₅
U_total = 3.0/50 + 28.5/1000 + 4.2/200 + 8.0/1000 + 2.0/5000
U_total = 0.0600 + 0.0285 + 0.0210 + 0.0080 + 0.0004
U_total = 0.1179
✓ U_total = 0.1179 ≤ 0.7435 = U_bound
∴ The task set is GUARANTEED SCHEDULABLE under RMS.
System operates at 15.9% of utilization ceiling → substantial headroom for future tasks.
